▶Your channel video player

Channel videos Ready to play videos that allow embedding.

Watch all your public uploads

Connect the channel's uploads playlist using its YouTube channel ID (starts with UC). This can play a sequence of uploaded videos without needing a separate tab.

Find your channel ID in YouTube Studio → Settings → Channel → Advanced settings. This saves it in your current browser. To make the uploads playlist appear automatically for every visitor, add the verified channel ID to the site code.

Play an individual video

Paste a public YouTube video link. It will play right here if YouTube permits embedding.

▶ Video Library

Search & watch supported YouTube videos

Find videos

To show live results here, an official YouTube Data API key is required. Watching a video link needs no key.

Enable in-page video search (optional)

Enter your own YouTube Data API v3 key. It is used only during this browser session, not saved into this site's code. Set HTTP referrer restrictions on the key before using it on a public website.
